book_name: 同桌英语《刘夏来语料库》4

words.ex: He will take part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参加学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To be involved in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.tr: phrase. 想出；构思出（主意、计划等）
words.ex: He can think up new ideas very fast.
words.ex_cn: 他能很快想出新点子。
words.en: To invent or devise something.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.ex: He used to play soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 他过去每天踢足球。
words.en: If something used to be done or used to be the case, it was done regularly in the past or was the case in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 清理；澄清；解决；放晴
words.ex: He helped to clear up the toys after playtime.
words.ex_cn: 他帮忙在玩完后收拾玩具。
words.en: To remove things that are causing a mess or obstruction; to explain something that was unclear; for the weather to become fine.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.ex: How did this mistake come about?
words.ex_cn: 这个错误是怎么发生的？
words.en: If you ask how something came about, you want to know how it happened or started.

words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.ex: How is your project getting on?
words.ex_cn: 你的项目进展如何？
words.en: If you get on with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them. If you get on with something, you continue doing it or start doing it.

words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.ex: It is pouring with rain outside.
words.ex_cn: 外面正下着倾盆大雨。
words.en: To rain heavily.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；解决；锻炼；进展（顺利）
words.ex: I can work out the answer with a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 我可以用计算器算出答案。
words.en: If you work out a solution to a problem or mystery, you think about it and find a solution. If you work out the answer to a mathematical problem, you calculate it. If a plan or situation works out, it happens or progresses in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.tr: phrase. 使用；接近；可以利用
words.ex: Students have access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后可以使用图书馆。
words.en: To have the right or opportunity to use or see something.

words.ex: He was inspired by his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他受到老师的启发。
words.en: To be stimulated or motivated by someone or something to do something creative or to feel a particular way.

words.ex: He decided to take control of his life.
words.ex_cn: 他决定掌控自己的生活。
words.en: To take control of something means to gain the power or authority to manage or direct it.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: He tries to cope with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To deal effectively with something difficult.

words.tr: n. 送别；欢送会；（尤指体育比赛中）开场前的仪式或活动
words.ex: They gave him a big sendoff before he left for work.
words.ex_cn: 他在出发去上班前，大家为他举行了盛大的送别。
words.en: A farewell party or gathering held for someone who is leaving, often to wish them well.

words.ex: He will sort out his books tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会整理好他的书。
words.en: To sort something out means to organize or arrange it, or to solve a problem or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. 修饰；润色；稍加改进（尤指绘画、照片或外观）
words.ex: He will touch up the painting before the show.
words.ex_cn: 他在展览前会稍微修饰一下这幅画。
words.en: To improve or finish something by making small changes or additions.

words.tr: phrase. 打包； 收拾；停止工作； 出故障
words.ex: He will pack up his clothes tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会收拾好他的衣服。
words.en: To put things into cases or boxes so that they can be transported or stored; to stop working or operating.

words.ex: The caterpillar turns into a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成了一只蝴蝶。
words.en: To change or develop into something different.

words.tr: phrase. 对...感到厌倦；对...失去兴趣
words.ex: He gets bored with the same movie every time.
words.ex_cn: 他每次看同一部电影都会感到无聊。
words.en: To lose interest in something over time.

words.tr: phrase. 穿戴；上演；增加（体重）
words.ex: He puts on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上外套。
words.en: To put on something means to dress oneself in it, or to start wearing it. It can also mean to produce a play, show, or other performance. Additionally, it can refer to gaining weight or to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality.

words.ex: Don't mix up the red and blue paints.
words.ex_cn: 别把红色和蓝色的颜料弄混了。
words.en: To confuse or mistake one thing for another.

words.ex: Her dream will come true next year.
words.ex_cn: 她的梦想明年将会实现。
words.en: If a dream, hope, or prediction comes true, it actually happens.

words.ex: He suffers from a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他患了重感冒。
words.en: If you suffer from an illness or from a medical condition, you are badly affected by it.

words.ex: We start off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey, activity, or process.

words.ex: He will stand in for the teacher today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天代替老师上课。
words.en: To take the place of someone or something temporarily.

words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.ex: Please bring along your notebook to class.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的笔记本带到课堂上来。
words.en: To take someone or something with you when you go somewhere.

words.tr: n. 外卖餐馆；外卖食物；
words.ex: We ordered dinner from the Chinese takeaway.
words.ex_cn: 我们从一家中餐外卖店点了晚餐。
words.en: A takeaway is a main point or piece of information that you learn from something such as a meeting, discussion, or document.

words.ex: He tried to fill up the hole with sand.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用沙子填补那个洞。
words.en: To make something full, or to become full.

words.tr: 专门研究，专攻；专门从事【动词短语】
words.ex: He specialises in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他专攻计算机科学。
words.en: To concentrate on and become expert in a particular subject or skill.

words.tr: phrase. 被迫接受（不想要的事物）；受困于；摆脱不掉
words.ex: He is stuck with a broken phone.
words.ex_cn: 他被困在一个坏掉的手机上。
words.en: If you are stuck with something, you have it and cannot get rid of it, even though you do not want it.

words.tr: phrase. 努力工作；勤奋劳动
words.ex: He work hard every day to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力工作来攒钱。
words.en: To put a lot of effort into one's job or a task.

words.tr: 短语 无法构成常见短语或固定搭配；'make way'意为让路，'up'为向上，二者组合无明确独立语义
words.ex: The phrase 'make way up' is not commonly used in English.
words.ex_cn: 短语 'make way up' 在英语中并不常用。
words.en: make way up: to advance or progress, especially in a career or hierarchy.

words.ex: It takes ages to download this file.
words.ex_cn: 下载这个文件要花很长时间。
words.en: If you say that something takes ages, you mean that it takes a very long time.

words.ex: I keep track of my expenses every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天记录我的开支。
words.en: To keep track of something means to stay informed about it or to record it, especially in order to notice any changes or developments.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 粉碎；磨碎；把……磨成粉末
words.ex: He will grind up the coffee beans in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 他早上会把咖啡豆磨碎。
words.en: To reduce something to small particles or powder by crushing or milling.

words.ex: The numbers don't add up.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字对不上。
words.en: If facts or events do not add up, they make you confused about a situation because they do not seem to be consistent. If small amounts of something add up, they gradually increase.

words.ex: He will take over the business next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将接管这家企业。
words.en: To take control of something, especially a company, by buying a majority of its shares or by getting a position of power within it.

words.ex: My grandfather passed down his old watch to me.
words.ex_cn: 我祖父把他的旧手表传给了我。
words.en: To transmit or hand down from one generation to another.

words.ex: The table is made from wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是用木头做的。
words.en: Created or produced using a particular material or substance as the main component.

words.ex: He can convert water into ice by freezing it.
words.ex_cn: 他可以通过冷冻把水变成冰。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change something so that it can be used for a different purpose or in a different way.

words.ex: He is satisfied with his test score.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的考试成绩感到满意。
words.en: Feeling contentment or happiness because one's needs or desires have been met.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.ex: They stock up on rice before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们在风暴来临前囤积大米。
words.en: To accumulate a large quantity of something for future use.

words.ex: They cut down the old tree in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把院子里那棵老树砍倒了。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, or number of something, or to do less of something.

words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于； 专心于
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To direct all your attention and effort towards a particular activity, subject, or problem.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；逐步增长；加强
words.ex: He builds up his strength by running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天跑步来增强体力。
words.en: To increase or develop something gradually; to accumulate or amass something over time.

words.ex: A problem came up during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议期间发生了一个问题。
words.en: To arise or occur, especially unexpectedly or as a subject of discussion.

words.tr: phrase. 突然出现；重新露面；调大
words.ex: He didn't turn up to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他没有出席会议。
words.en: To arrive or appear somewhere, often unexpectedly; to increase the volume or intensity of something.

words.ex: They booked up all the rooms for the conference.
words.ex_cn: 他们把会议的所有房间都订满了。
words.en: To reserve or arrange for something, like a ticket or appointment.

words.ex: He is concerned about his grades.
words.ex_cn: 他担心自己的成绩。
words.en: Worried or anxious about something.

words.tr: phrase. 减少；落下；睡着；让...下车
words.ex: The number of students dropped off last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学生人数减少了。
words.en: If the level, amount, or value of something drops off, it becomes less.

words.tr: phrase. 把它们捡起来；接载他们；顺便带他们走
words.ex: I will pick them up after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后去接他们。
words.en: pick them up: to collect someone or something, often from a specific location.

words.ex: He looked through the book quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速翻阅了那本书。
words.en: To look through something means to examine or read it quickly or casually.

words.ex: He must face up to his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的错误。
words.en: If you face up to a difficult situation, you accept it and deal with it honestly and bravely.

words.tr: phrase. 吓跑；使害怕而离开
words.ex: Loud noises can frighten away small animals.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的声音会吓跑小动物。
words.en: To cause someone or something to go away or stay away because they are frightened.

words.ex: He got a printout of his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他打印了一份作业。
words.en: A printout is a piece of paper on which information from a computer or similar device has been printed.

words.tr: phrase. 随身携带；带在身边
words.ex: Don't forget to take along with you your ID card.
words.ex_cn: 别忘了随身携带你的身份证。
words.en: To bring something with you when you go somewhere.

words.tr: phrase. 动身； 出发；着手；陈述
words.ex: They set out early to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他们早早出发去赶公交车。
words.en: To begin a journey or to start doing something with a particular aim.

words.ex: He gave up smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年戒烟了。
words.en: If you give up something, you stop doing it or having it.

words.ex: There is plenty of food on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌上有很多食物。
words.en: A large quantity or number; more than enough.

words.ex: This book costs the same price as that one.
words.ex_cn: 这本书和那本书价格一样。
words.en: the same price as: costing an identical amount of money as something else.

words.tr: phrase. 正如你所看到的，用于引出显而易见的事实或情况
words.ex: As you can see, the book is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 正如你所见，书在桌子上。
words.en: As you can observe or understand from the current situation.

words.tr: phrase. 直到最后；一直到底
words.ex: He kept running right to the end.
words.ex_cn: 他一直跑到最后。
words.en: Continuing until the very end without stopping or giving up.

words.tr: 感叹语。真令人失望；太扫兴了
words.ex: It was what a let down when the movie ended so boringly.
words.ex_cn: 当电影结束得如此无聊时，真是令人失望。
words.en: An expression of disappointment when something fails to meet expectations.

words.ex: He went running despite the fact that it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是去跑步了。
words.en: In spite of the fact that; although.

words.ex: He is anything but lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他绝不是懒惰的。
words.en: You use anything but in expressions such as anything but quiet and anything but happy to emphasize that something is not the case.

words.ex: He spoke with regard to the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他谈到了新规定。
words.en: Used to introduce the subject that one is going to talk or write about.

words.ex: A number of students are late for class.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生上课迟到了。
words.en: An indefinite but considerable amount or quantity of something.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.ex: He was busy at the moment.
words.ex_cn: 当时他很忙。
words.en: At the moment is used to indicate that something is happening now.

words.tr: phrase. 大部分时间；通常；多半时候
words.ex: Most of the time, he walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 大多数时候，他走路去学校。
words.en: On most occasions; usually.

words.ex: He arrived late, as usual.
words.ex_cn: 他像往常一样迟到了。
words.en: As usual means in the same way as what happens most of the time or in most cases.

words.ex: The most important is that you try your best.
words.ex_cn: 最重要的是你要尽力。
words.en: The most important point or fact is that

words.ex: This shoe is suitable for walking.
words.ex_cn: 这双鞋适合走路。
words.en: If something is suitable for a particular purpose or person, it is right or acceptable for that purpose or person.

words.tr: phrase. 大范围的；范围广泛的
words.ex: The store has a wide range of toys for children.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店有各种各样的儿童玩具。
words.en: A wide range of means there is a large variety or a great number of different things within a particular category.

words.tr: phrase. 差异；区别（用于表示两者之间的不同）
words.ex: There is a big difference between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子之间有很大的差异。
words.en: The distinction or contrast between two things

words.tr: phrase. 要么……要么……；不是……就是……（用于连接两个选择）
words.ex: You can have either tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 你可以选择茶或咖啡。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.ex: He broke the vase on purpose.
words.ex_cn: 他故意打碎了花瓶。
words.en: If you do something on purpose, you do it intentionally, not by accident.

words.tr: phrase. 宁可 ... 也不愿；与其 ... 倒不如；而不是
words.ex: He chose to walk rather than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: used to say that one thing is preferred to another or happens instead of another

words.tr: phrase. 在...外；从里面；出于；在...范围外；离开
words.ex: The ball rolled out of the box.
words.ex_cn: 球滚到了盒子外面。
words.en: used to indicate movement or direction from the inside to the outside of a place or thing; used to indicate the cause or reason for something; used to indicate a lack or absence of something

words.ex: I need a couple of minutes to finish this.
words.ex_cn: 我需要几分钟来完成这个。
words.en: A couple of is used to refer to a small number of things or people, usually two or a few more than two.

words.tr: phrase. 多达；直到；在于…；能胜任
words.ex: The box can hold up to ten books.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子最多能放十本书。
words.en: used to say that something is the responsibility of someone or that someone has the ability to decide something

words.tr: phrase. 环保的；有利于环境的
words.ex: This bag is environmentally friendly.
words.ex_cn: 这个袋子对环境友好。
words.en: Environmentally friendly refers to goods, services, laws, guidelines, and policies that inflict minimal or no harm upon the environment or ecosystems.

words.tr: phrase. 使自己熟悉环境或情况
words.ex: Please orientate yourself with the map before we start.
words.ex_cn: 在我们出发前，请用地图熟悉一下环境。
words.en: To familiarize yourself with a new environment or situation.

words.ex: There are dozens of apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有很多苹果。
words.en: If you refer to dozens of things or people, you are emphasizing that there are very many of them.

words.tr: 我猜是这样；我想是这样的
words.ex: I suppose so, but I am not sure.
words.ex_cn: 我猜是这样，但我不确定。
words.en: Used to express hesitant agreement or acceptance.

words.tr: phrase. 对…产生重要的影响
words.ex: Smoking has a significant effect on your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有重大影响。
words.en: To cause a major impact or change on something.

words.tr: phrase. 对……做出了巨大贡献
words.ex: He made a big contribution to the project.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个项目做出了巨大贡献。
words.en: Provided significant help or support to

words.tr: 短语：哪个是主要观点；哪个是重点
words.ex: He gave three reasons; which is the main point?
words.ex_cn: 他给出了三个理由，哪个是主要观点？
words.en: Which is the most important aspect or purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 进行付款；支付款项
words.ex: He makes payments every month for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月为他的车付款。
words.en: To give money in exchange for goods or services.

words.tr: phrase. 好观点；有道理的说法
words.ex: You made a good point about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 你对天气说了一个很好的观点。
words.en: A good point is a valid or insightful observation or idea.

words.ex: He has loads of books in his room.
words.ex_cn: 他房间里有很多书。
words.en: A large amount or number of something.

words.w: has a lot to do with it
words.tr: 与……有很大关系；在很大程度上取决于……
words.uk: hæz ə lɒt tə duː wɪð ɪt
words.us: hæz ə lɑːt tə du wɪð ɪt
words.ex: Success has a lot to do with hard work.
words.ex_cn: 成功与努力工作有很大关系。
words.en: to be closely related or connected to something

words.tr: phrase. 保养良好的；维护得当的
words.ex: The garden is well maintained by the owner.
words.ex_cn: 这个花园由主人精心维护。
words.en: In good condition because of regular care and maintenance.

words.tr: phrase. 几乎没有，几乎一点也没有
words.ex: There are hardly any apples left in the basket.
words.ex_cn: 篮子里几乎没有苹果了。
words.en: used to emphasize that there is almost none of something or that something almost never happens

words.ex: He runs more than ten times a week.
words.ex_cn: 他一周跑步超过十次。
words.en: A quantity exceeding tenfold

words.ex: He takes a taxi to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上打车去上班。
words.en: To travel by taxi, which is a car that you can hire to take you to a particular place.

words.tr: 短语. 本来会期望；原本预料会……（表示对过去未发生情况的推测或遗憾）
words.ex: I would have expected him to be late.
words.ex_cn: 我本以为他会迟到。
words.en: Used to express what one thought was likely to happen in the past.

words.ex: He is known as a good teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被称为一位好老师。
words.en: If someone or something is known as a particular name, they are called by that name.

words.tr: 关于……的描述或记录；对……的说明
words.ex: He wrote accounts of his travels in Africa.
words.ex_cn: 他写了关于他在非洲旅行的记录。
words.en: Detailed reports or narratives describing events or situations.

words.ex: This book is similar to the one I read last week.
words.ex_cn: 这本书和我上周读的那本很相似。
words.en: resembling or alike; having qualities in common.

words.tr: phrase. 好像...似的； 仿佛...一样
words.ex: He talks as if he knows everything.
words.ex_cn: 他说话的样子好像什么都知道。
words.en: used to describe how someone or something appears or behaves, suggesting that the appearance or behavior is not real or true

words.ex: He has less than five apples.
words.ex_cn: 他不到五个苹果。
words.en: If something is less than a particular amount, it is not as much as that amount.

words.tr: phrase. 对……的威胁；危及……的事物
words.ex: The pollution is a threat to the fish.
words.ex_cn: 污染对鱼类构成了威胁。
words.en: A potential source of harm or danger.

words.tr: 不仅……而且其他……（用于强调除了前面提到的事物之外还有其他事物）
words.ex: He is not just a teacher but other things like a writer and a musician.
words.ex_cn: 他不仅是一名老师，而且还是一名作家和音乐家。
words.en: Not only one thing but also something else

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.ex: That sounds good.
words.ex_cn: 那听起来不错。
words.en: An expression of agreement, approval, or that something is satisfactory.

words.tr: phrase. 我认为如此；我想是这样
words.ex: I think so.
words.ex_cn: 我认为是这样。
words.en: An expression of tentative agreement or belief.

words.ex: He is interested in math.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学感兴趣。
words.en: To have a feeling of curiosity or concern about something, wanting to learn or know more about it.

words.w: have a long way to go
words.tr: 短语动词. 还有很长的路要走；还有很多工作要做才能成功或达到目标
words.uk: hæv ə lɒŋ weɪ tə ɡəʊ
words.us: hæv ə lɔːŋ weɪ tə ɡoʊ
words.ex: We have a long way to go to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 我们还有很多工作要做才能完成这个项目。
words.en: If you say that something or someone has a long way to go, you mean that they need to make a lot of progress or change a lot before they can achieve something.

words.tr: 短语. 就……而言；就……所知（通常用于表达个人观点或立场，完整表达常为 'as far as I am concerned'，意为‘就我而言’）
words.ex: As far as I'm concerned, the meeting can be canceled.
words.ex_cn: 就我而言，会议可以取消。
words.en: with regard to; concerning.

words.ex: I will have a word with him about his noise.
words.ex_cn: 我会跟他谈谈他的噪音问题。
words.en: To speak to someone briefly, especially in order to give them a warning or to tell them something important.

words.tr: phrase. 很难跟上的；相当难以理解的
words.ex: The math lesson was quite hard to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这节数学课很难跟上。
words.en: Difficult to understand or follow.

words.ex: I hadn't expected it to rain today.
words.ex_cn: 我没想到今天会下雨。
words.en: If you hadn't expected something, you did not think it would happen.

words.ex: I want the red shirt — that's the one.
words.ex_cn: 我想要那件红色的衬衫——就是那个。
words.en: Used to confirm or identify something previously mentioned.

words.w: I knew a bit about it
words.uk: aɪ njuː ə bɪt əˈbaʊt ɪt
words.us: aɪ nuː ə bɪt əˈbaʊt ɪt
words.ex: I knew a bit about algebra when I was in middle school.
words.ex_cn: 我上中学时对代数有一点了解。
words.en: Had some knowledge or understanding of it

words.ex: He got going with it to fix the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他用它去修那把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: Begin or continue the activity.

words.tr: 短语，表示“……之类的；……这种类型的”
words.ex: He likes the sorts of movies that make him laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢让他笑的那种电影。
words.en: A variety of different types or kinds.

words.ex: The mountains formed over millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 这些山脉是在数百万年中形成的。
words.en: Over a vast period of geological time, spanning millions of years.

words.tr: phrase. 能够……的；有能力做……的
words.ex: He is able to swim across the river.
words.ex_cn: 他能游过这条河。
words.en: Having the necessary power, skill, or resources to do something.

words.ex: What is going on here?
words.ex_cn: 这里正在发生什么？
words.en: Happening or taking place; also used to ask about current events or situations.

words.ex: I like coffee, on the other hand, my brother prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，另一方面，我弟弟更喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously

words.tr: phrase. v. 习惯于；变得适应
words.ex: He got accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯了早起。
words.en: To become familiar with something or someone so that it seems normal or usual.

words.ex: He is not just a teacher but also a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他不仅是一名老师，还是一名作家。
words.en: Not only one thing but also another

words.ex: He didn't meet up to that standard.
words.ex_cn: 他没有达到那个标准。
words.en: Meeting the required level of quality or excellence.

words.tr: phrase. 在我的空闲时间；闲暇时
words.ex: In my free time, I read books.
words.ex_cn: 在我空闲时间，我读书。
words.en: During the time when I am not working or occupied.

words.ex: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
words.ex_cn: 带把伞，以防下雨。
words.en: used to describe a situation where you do something in order to be prepared for a possible future event

words.ex: He bought apples, bananas, and so on.
words.ex_cn: 他买了苹果、香蕉等等。
words.en: Used at the end of a list to indicate that there are other items that could also be mentioned.

words.tr: phrase. 下订单；订购；提出订货要求
words.ex: He put in an order for pizza last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚点了一份披萨。
words.en: To request goods or services from a supplier or manufacturer.

words.ex: He runs pretty fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得相当快。
words.en: Relatively quickly.

words.tr: 短语。就是这个；就这样；完了；对了（表示确认、结束或强调）
words.ex: I found the key! That's it!
words.ex_cn: 我找到钥匙了！就是这个！
words.en: used to say that something is finished or that something is all that there is

words.ex: He drank a bottle of water after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后喝了一瓶水。
words.en: A bottle of water refers to a container filled with water, typically made of plastic or glass, used for drinking.

words.ex: He is going about it the wrong way.
words.ex_cn: 他做这件事的方法错了。
words.en: Dealing with or approaching a task or situation

words.tr: phrase. 与……有关联；卷入；涉及
words.ex: He doesn't want to involve with that problem.
words.ex_cn: 他不想与那个问题有关联。
words.en: To participate in or be connected to an activity or situation.

words.ex: The lights went out all at once.
words.ex_cn: 灯一下子全灭了。
words.en: Suddenly; at the same time.

words.tr: 短语. 由你决定；取决于你
words.ex: It is up to you to decide.
words.ex_cn: 决定权在你。
words.en: It means that the decision is yours to make; you have the authority or freedom to choose.

words.ex: The factory uses recycled materials to make new bottles.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用可再生材料制造新瓶子。
words.en: Materials that have been processed and converted into raw materials for new products.

words.tr: phrase. 令人愉快的景色；宜人的景观
words.ex: She enjoys a pleasant view from her window.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢从窗户看到的美丽景色。
words.en: A sight that is pleasing to the eye, often because of its beauty or tranquility.

words.tr: phrase. 头脑风暴会议；集体讨论以产生创意或解决问题的会议
words.ex: We had a brainstorming session to find new ideas.
words.ex_cn: 我们举行了一次头脑风暴会议来寻找新点子。
words.en: A brainstorming session is a meeting where people come together to generate ideas and solutions to a problem.

words.tr: phrase. 提及；涉及；参考；引用于
words.ex: He made a reference to his old teacher in the speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中提到了他的老老师。
words.en: A mention or allusion to something or someone.

words.ex: He has insight into how the machine works.
words.ex_cn: 他了解这台机器的工作原理。
words.en: An understanding of the true nature of something.

words.tr: phrase. 对……的了解；对……的概念
words.ex: He has an idea of how to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他大概知道如何解决这个问题。
words.en: A general understanding or concept of

words.tr: phrase. 休息时间；间歇时间
words.ex: We have a break time at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们在下午三点有休息时间。
words.en: A period of rest or relaxation from work or study.

words.ex: He is talking all the time.
words.ex_cn: 他一直在说话。
words.en: If something happens or is done all the time, it happens or is done continually or repeatedly.

words.ex: The job offers good health benefits.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作提供良好的医疗福利。
words.en: Health benefits refer to the positive effects on health that result from certain actions, such as exercise, diet, or abstaining from harmful habits.

words.tr: phrase. 职业阶梯；事业晋升途径
words.ex: He climbed the career ladder quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速爬上了职业阶梯。
words.en: The progressive sequence of jobs or positions that lead to higher levels of responsibility and pay in a profession.

words.tr: phrase. 客户服务；顾客服务
words.ex: The customer service helped me fix my order.
words.ex_cn: 客服帮助我解决了我的订单问题。
words.en: The assistance and advice provided by a company to those people who buy or use its products or services.

words.tr: phrase. （职位、空缺等）的空缺；用于表示某职位或机会尚无人担任或占据
words.ex: There is a vacancy for a teacher at the school.
words.ex_cn: 学校里有一个教师的空缺。
words.en: A job or position that is available to be filled.

words.ex: He got his driving licence last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月拿到了驾照。
words.en: A driving licence is an official document permitting a specific individual to operate one or more types of motorized vehicles on public roads.

words.tr: phrase. 旺季；旅游高峰季节
words.ex: Tourists visit the beach in high season.
words.ex_cn: 游客在旺季去海滩。
words.en: The period of the year when a particular place is most popular with tourists and prices are at their highest.

words.ex: The traffic and road transport are very busy in the city.
words.ex_cn: 城市里的交通和道路运输非常繁忙。
words.en: The movement of vehicles and the system of roads

words.ex: Smoking is the main cause of lung cancer.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟是肺癌的主要原因。
words.en: The primary reason or factor that leads to a particular result or situation.

words.ex: People used tools thousands of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 几千年前，人们就使用工具了。
words.en: a period of time consisting of a thousand years, often used to describe a very long time.

words.tr: phrase. 低热量饮食；低卡路里膳食
words.ex: He follows low calorie diets to lose weight.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循低热量饮食来减肥。
words.en: Eating plans that are low in calories, often for weight loss or health reasons.

words.ex: He started dieting for weight loss.
words.ex_cn: 他开始节食以减肥。
words.en: The process of losing body weight, either by diet, exercise, or both.

words.tr: phrase. 名单/列表的首位；最优先的位置
words.ex: Her name is at the top of the list.
words.ex_cn: 她的名字在名单最上面。
words.en: The highest priority or most important item.

words.tr: 短语. 在...方面的跃升；在...方面的突然增加
words.ex: There was a jump in prices last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月价格有所上涨。
words.en: A sudden and significant increase in something, often numbers or rates.

words.ex: He got a whole new set of tools for his workshop.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车间买了一整套新工具。
words.en: a completely new collection or group of

words.ex: The government helps urban and rural areas with better roads.
words.ex_cn: 政府为城市和农村地区提供更好的道路。
words.en: Geographical regions characterized by differing population densities, infrastructure, and lifestyles: urban areas are densely populated with extensive services, while rural areas are sparsely populated with agricultural or natural landscapes.

words.tr: phrase. 长期影响；长远含义；长期后果
words.ex: The policy has long-term implications for the environment.
words.ex_cn: 这项政策对环境有长期影响。
words.en: The future consequences or effects of a decision or event.

words.tr: phrase. 体能水平；健康程度；身体状况
words.ex: His level of fitness improved after running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步后，体能水平提高了。
words.en: A measure of physical health and endurance.

words.ex: The students wait at the main gate after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们放学后在正门等候。
words.en: The main entrance to a place, especially a large building or area.

words.ex: It takes an hour and a half to walk to school.
words.ex_cn: 走路去学校需要一个半小时。
words.en: A period of ninety minutes.

words.ex: The local community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 当地社区一起清理了公园。
words.en: A local community is a group of people living in the same place or having a particular characteristic in common, often sharing interests and goals.

words.tr: phrase. 时间投入；时间承诺；指为某项任务或活动所承诺或必须花费的时间
words.ex: She made a big time commitment to learn piano.
words.ex_cn: 她为学习钢琴投入了大量时间。
words.en: The amount of time that one is required or expected to devote to a particular activity or cause.

words.ex: He will call you at the end of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他会在会议结束时给你打电话。
words.en: Indicates the final part of a period of time, an event, a process, or a physical object.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的前面；位于……的前部
words.ex: He stands at the front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他站在教室的前面。
words.en: Located at the foremost part or position of something.

words.ex: He explained the rule in relation to the example.
words.ex_cn: 他结合例子解释了这个规则。
words.en: Concerning or in connection with something.

words.tr: phrase. 依次；轮流；结果；反过来
words.ex: The students spoke in turn to answer the teacher's question.
words.ex_cn: 学生们依次回答老师的问题。
words.en: You use in turn to refer to actions or events that are in a sequence one after the other, especially because one causes the other.

words.ex: The fire is under control.
words.ex_cn: 火势得到了控制。
words.en: If a situation or a person is under control, they are being dealt with successfully and there is no danger of them becoming unmanageable.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的根本上；在……的根源处
words.ex: Honesty is at the very root of trust.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是信任的根本。
words.en: at the most fundamental or basic level of something

words.ex: He wrote the letter by hand.
words.ex_cn: 他亲手写了这封信。
words.en: If something is done by hand, it is done using someone's hands rather than a machine.

words.ex: People all over the world like chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 全世界的人都喜欢巧克力。
words.en: everywhere in the world

words.tr: n. 应力不足，加压不足
words.ex: The pipe failed due to understress during the test.
words.ex_cn: 管道在测试中因应力不足而失效。
words.en: To work or live under pressure, experiencing stress.

words.tr: phrase. prep. 远离；离开（某人或某物）
words.ex: He walked away from the house.
words.ex_cn: 他走离了房子。
words.en: at a distance from a particular place or person

words.tr: 短语. 首先，一开始（用于引出第一个理由或问题）
words.ex: For a start, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: Used to introduce the first point in a discussion or argument.

words.ex: At the beginning, he walked to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 一开始，他每天步行去学校。
words.en: At the start of something.

words.tr: phrase. 同时；但是；在相同的时间
words.ex: He sings and dances at the same time.
words.ex_cn: 他一边唱歌一边跳舞。
words.en: If two or more things exist, happen, or are true at the same time, they exist, happen, or are true together although they seem to contradict each other.

words.ex: He played soccer in the past.
words.ex_cn: 他过去踢足球。
words.en: At a time before the present; in earlier times.

words.tr: phrase. 久而久之；随着时间的过去
words.ex: He gets better over time.
words.ex_cn: 他随着时间的推移变得更好。
words.en: If something happens over time, it happens gradually during a long period.

words.ex: I will buy a new phone in the near future.
words.ex_cn: 我将在不久的将来买一部新手机。
words.en: At a time that is not far away from now.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 朝相反方向；向反方向
words.ex: The car moved in the opposite direction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车朝相反的方向行驶。
words.en: Moving or facing away from each other or from a particular point.

words.ex: He says he likes sports, but in fact, he hates them.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢运动，但事实上，他讨厌它们。
words.en: You use in fact to emphasize that something is true, especially when it contradicts what has just been said or might be expected.

words.tr: phrase. 现存的；存在的；仍然活着的
words.ex: The oldest tree in the world is still in existence.
words.ex_cn: 世界上最古老的树仍然存在。
words.en: Currently existing or being in the present state.

words.tr: phrase. 很长一段时间；很久
words.ex: He has been sick for a long time.
words.ex_cn: 他病了很久。
words.en: For a long time refers to a period that is lengthy or extended, often implying that the duration is significant or noteworthy.

words.tr: 短语. 在预算范围内；未超出预算
words.ex: We stayed within budget for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们这次旅行没有超支。
words.en: If something is within budget, it does not exceed the amount of money that has been allocated for it.

words.ex: In the end, he chose to go home.
words.ex_cn: 最后，他选择回家。
words.en: finally, after everything has been considered or done

words.ex: At present, he is working as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 目前，他是一名老师。
words.en: At the present time; now.

words.ex: They live by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在海边。
words.en: At or near the sea.
